name: Executive
description: The default lens: role and org context, active projects, regular collaborators, current priorities, and team vocabulary.

questions.question: First up: what's your role, and what kind of organization do you work in?
questions.followup: Got it. Anything else about the context worth knowing -- your team, your department, who you answer to?

questions.question: What projects are you actively working on? One line each, using their real names -- plus any shorthand, aliases, or codenames people use for them.
questions.followup: That was quick -- any others, even back-burner ones? Shorthand and codenames welcome.

questions.question: Who do you work with regularly? Names as they'd appear in a meeting transcript, plus any nicknames.
questions.followup: Anyone else -- even occasional collaborators whose names show up in transcripts?

questions.question: What are your current priorities, and what does "done" look like for the big ones?
questions.followup: And roughly when or how would you call the biggest one done?

questions.question: Last one: any team vocabulary worth knowing? Acronyms, codenames, shorthand that shows up in meetings.
